config.scope: Opened-bank development benchmark, no fresh confirmation, no utility forecast
config.controlled: original authored banks/original single heads/maps; equal two corpora, macroOVR classes
config.sentiment: naturalV2 TRAIN256+SELECT128+CAL128, equal five fixed training resamples and four corpora; original saved decisions/draws; legacy templates separate
config.missing: null without renormalization; no self incoming; Qwen LSO descriptive only

ranking.multiclass_logistic: class log-odds zc-logsumexp(other logits), monotone with softmax class probability, robust to saturation
ranking.multiclass_ridge: log(max(zc,1e-6))-logsumexp(log(max(zothers,1e-6))); legacy semantic contract retained for numeric-only audit
ranking.faithful_multiclass_ridge: log(max(zc,1e-6))-logsumexp(log(max(zothers,1e-6))); legacy semantic contract retained for numeric-only audit
ranking.support: excluded0; preserve gated product semantic, audit stable logistic product logit and clipped ridge product; no conversion to ungated task
ranking.raw_multiclass_OVR: diagnostic fixture only, never silently primary

config.calibration: All original probabilities/cuts/inequality >= unchanged; zero TEST recalibration
config.uncertainty: 500 paired group draws conditional fixed fits; task banks independent draws; natural training spread separate, controlled single-fit not promoted to overall training uncertainty
config.development_amendment: Post-audit original-confidence-target preservation; not a winner-dependent recipe switch. All earlier4.0 results preserved.
